# Conserved-currency nonlinear Markov receiver

29 October 2026. Ideal real-valued/random-source mathematics, not a finite-bit
output or physical gas qualification. This file derives the model transformation;
termination and costs are in PROOF.md. Historical priority is UNKNOWN.

## 1. Actual hard-sphere convention

For probability measures f_t on R^3, use the homogeneous weak equation

    d <phi,f>/dt = int f(dv) f(dw) |v-w| E_sigma[phi(p)-phi(v)],
    p=(v+w+|v-w|sigma)/2, q=(v+w-|v-w|sigma)/2,

where sigma is uniform on the unit sphere. Thus the angular measure has total
mass one. There is no additional 4pi, half-rate, Maxwell approximation, Gaussian
blur commutation or finite-population approximation in this convention.
Exchange v,w and sigma -> -sigma gives the equivalent pair-symmetric expression
one half times [phi(p)+phi(q)-phi(v)-phi(w)].

Fix a>0, e0=int |v|^2 f0(dv), c=a+e0, h(v)=a+|v|^2. Elasticity gives

    h(p)+h(q)=h(v)+h(w).

Suppose provisionally g_t(dv)=h(v)f_t(dv)/c. It is a probability law.

## 2. A normalized positive update

For current v, propose events at rate

    Lambda(v)=(c/a)(|v|+sqrt(a)).

At an event at time s, obtain an independent w with law g_s and accept with

    Q(v,w)=c |v-w|/[h(w)Lambda(v)]
          =a |v-w|/[(a+|w|^2)(|v|+sqrt(a))].

This is in [0,1]: if x=|v|/sqrt(a),y=|w|/sqrt(a), triangle inequality reduces
the claim to x+y <= (1+y^2)(x+1), whose excess is
x y^2+(y-1/2)^2+3/4. A rejection keeps v.
On acceptance draw sigma, form p,q, and retain p with probability
h(p)/[h(p)+h(q)], otherwise retain q. No signed or multiplicative output mass
is introduced. This extra outgoing selection is essential; simply deleting
the mass variable in Fournier's ordinary recursion is incorrect.

For a test psi the normalized nonlinear generator is

    G_g(psi)=int g(dv)g(dw) c |v-w|/h(w)
       { [h(p)psi(p)+h(q)psi(q)]/[h(v)+h(w)] - psi(v) }.

Exchange the two iid inputs. The gain coefficient becomes

    (c |v-w|/2)(1/h(v)+1/h(w))/(h(v)+h(w))
      =c |v-w|/[2h(v)h(w)].

The loss symmetrizes with exactly the same coefficient. Therefore

    G_g(psi)=int g(dv)g(dw) c |v-w|/[2h(v)h(w)]
       [h(p)psi(p)+h(q)psi(q)-h(v)psi(v)-h(w)psi(w)].       (G)

Substituting g=hf/c shows G_g(psi)=(1/c) d<h psi,f>/dt.
This proves the generator identity without assuming a g sampler exists.

# Normalized hard-sphere sampling by conserved-currency recursion

29 October 2026. This is an ideal-real/random-source operation for the explicitly
normalized homogeneous three-dimensional hard-sphere equation in GENERATOR.md.
It does not assert a finite-bit continuous output, uniform-in-time work, empirical
gas identification, historical novelty or practical superiority to DSMC.

## 1. Input and theorem

Input is a probability source f0 on R^3 with warranted support |v|<=R, exact known
energy e0=int |v|^2 f0(dv), and an independent source sampler. Fix a>0 and put
h(v)=a+|v|^2, c=a+e0, Lambda(v)=c(|v|+sqrt(a))/a. Source g0=hf0/c must be
sampleable: rejection with envelope a+R^2 supplies it, or an explicit finite
source table can be reweighted. The zero-energy point source may simply be
returned unchanged; no division by e0 is needed if a is otherwise chosen.

For every finite time t>=0, the recursive algorithm below terminates almost
surely, has finite expected total calls and returns a g_t-distributed velocity.
The subsequent a/h rejection returns iid velocities with law f_t, the unique
conservative solution of the actual hard-sphere equation. There is no population
limit, time mesh, weighted output, velocity cutoff or unknown partner-law oracle.
The theorem remains conditional on ideal arithmetic and the stated source.

## 2. Algorithm, including all dummy events

`currency(t)`:

1. Draw v from g0 and set s=0.
2. Draw E of unit exponential law; set s <- s+E/Lambda(v).
3. If s>t, return v. Otherwise call `currency(s)` independently to obtain w.
4. Accept with Q(v,w)=c|v-w|/[h(w)Lambda(v)]. If rejected, keep v. If accepted,
   draw a uniform unit vector sigma, compute elastic p,q, and replace v by p
   with probability h(p)/(h(p)+h(q)), otherwise by q.
5. Return to step 2.

`physical(t)`: independently repeat `currency(t)` and retain the result with
probability a/h(v). The generator identity and physical-law rejection are in
GENERATOR.md. Crucially even rejected collision proposals require the partner
call; its entire cost is counted.

# What normalized hard-sphere output actually enables

The operation constructed in GENERATOR.md and PROOF.md gives independent
unit-weight f_t outputs at any fixed finite time, with finite expected cost.
For a supplied observable phi in [-1,1], the ordinary empirical average of n
outputs therefore obeys

    P(|average(phi)-int phi f_t|>epsilon) <= 2 exp(-n epsilon^2/2).

For J such observables, a union bound changes 2 to 2J. Thus
n>=2 epsilon^(-2) log(2J/delta) is a distribution-free output-sampling
guarantee in the ideal model. No second moment of a random importance weight
is required. This is a standard consequence of the newly normalized output,
not a new concentration inequality or a numerical proof of Boltzmann dynamics.

With a=e0>0 and B,L from PROOF.md, one complete g tree has
E N<=exp(Lt)-1, hence at most 2exp(Lt) expected frames across the final
physical rejection. It has at most 4exp(Lt) expected exponential draws and
2exp(Lt) expected event proposals, with the sharper additive constants in
the governing proof. Finite-table source preprocessing and categorical
selection must be charged separately. Rejection-based g0 construction also
costs (a+R^2)/c raw source draws per g0 draw in expectation.

An explicit high-confidence work cap follows, if wanted, by Markov's inequality:
for n requested outputs and an expected total primitive work bound W, a cap
2W/delta causes at most delta/2 probability of an unfinished computation.
Use delta/2 for the Hoeffding event. An over-cap execution returns an explicit
failure, not a biased substitute sample. This cap can be very large; expected
finite work is not a useful worst-case or long-time complexity bound.

The same claim cannot be assigned to Fournier's weighted output merely by
inserting its observed finite empirical weight variance: E[M_t^2] is not
established by that construction. Conversely, finite-N Kac/DSMC is far cheaper
in the executed comparison, and standard propagation-of-chaos/numerical tools
may qualify its population error on a chosen task. No superiority over that
equally informed qualified route is established here.

The literal program uses binary64 and a seeded generator. Its outputs are
diagnostics of the ideal operation, not exact continuous-law or bit-complexity
receipts. Root's separate finite-bit Maxwell work is not consumed for the
velocity-dependent-rate model.
